## Description

**What**: Migrate every consumer enumerated in tests/audits/A0-stack-consumer-inventory.md from singular-equality patterns to array-membership queries. Known consumers: resolve-stack-adapter.sh:44, prefill-config.sh:138, project-detect.sh:346,348 (plus any additional hits found by the audit).
**Why**: Consumers must read the new array schema; legacy singular-equality patterns silently miss polyglot stacks.
**Scope**:
- IN: One-by-one rewrite of each inventory hit using array-membership query pattern documented in DETECTION-SCHEMA.md; verify post-migration audit script returns zero legacy-pattern hits across plugins/ and .claude/; preserve existing semantics (no behavior change beyond schema awareness).
- OUT: Pre-commit hook (separate story); auto-migration of configs (separate story); detect-stack.sh rewrite (separate story).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, every entry in tests/audits/A0-stack-consumer-inventory.md is migrated to array-membership query pattern ← Satisfies: "All consumers migrated"
- When complete, the post-migration audit script returns zero legacy-pattern matches across plugins/ and .claude/ ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, dso:completion-verifier confirms inventory checklist is 100% checked ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations
- [Maintainability] Use array-membership idiom consistently — document chosen pattern in DETECTION-SCHEMA.md and mirror it everywhere
- [Testing] Post-migration audit run is gating — must pass in CI

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a maintainer, every legacy stack-keyed consumer is migrated to array-membership queries
